basis: The vertical legend maps pale yellow to the high end (High/100) and dark burgundy to the low end (Low/0). Among the offered states, Utah (UT) is filled with the palest yellow (near 100), Delaware (DE) is a more saturated light yellow (between 80 and 100), and Vermont (VT) is dark burgundy (near 0). Therefore, Utah has the highest encoded risk index and is the record to route into the highest-risk priority follow-up workflow.
